title: Home-court pinned to the measured home-win rate, and the travel term's status
conversion: HCA = sigma * Phi^-1(P(home win)); sigma = 11.0 points, the spread of a final margin

assumption_replaced.status: documented assumption (flag E-01), not a measurement

results_feed.note: mean_home_margin_points is the direct arithmetic estimate (no normality assumption); implied_hca_points is the same rate read through the model's margin spread. They differ because the season's home margins are skewed by blowouts on both sides.

official_standings_home_column.excludes: neutral-site games (the page books them in their own column)

travel.status: NOT MODELLED - no sourced arena-coordinate table exists in this repository
travel.what_would_close_it: add data/official/arena_coordinates.json: for each of the 30 arenas, the arena name, the city as printed on the NBA.com game card, and a latitude/longitude pair, each with the URL it was read from and the read time. Great-circle distance is then pure arithmetic and every number on the page stays traceable.
travel.why_not_filled_in: no NBA-operated source reachable from this build publishes arena coordinates, and distances from memory would be untraceable values in a table whose whole purpose is traceability.

pin_basis: mean of the two measured pins (results feed and standings HOME column). It is published as a PIN, not as a third rating: the model either uses it or it does not, and every page states which. The two measurements and the fitted value are printed beside each other because they disagree.

adoption.why_not_applied_retroactively: the 60 horizon picks are frozen and hashed (data/live/ledger_2026-11-15.json); moving their lines after tip would make the settlement test the pre-registration was written to protect. The pin therefore takes effect at the next freeze, and the sensitivity of every already-published line to it is printed on the day-roll page instead of being applied silently.
adoption.sensitivity_note: home-court enters the line additively, so the effect of the pin on any published margin is exactly (pinned - 2.5) points, and zero on totals.
